mapper.sql: SELECT su.id, su.username, su.phone, su.email, su.credit, su.status, su.last_login_time AS lastLoginTime, su.create_time, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_name AS roleName, COALESCE(up.nickname, su.username) AS nickname, up.avatar, up.bio FROM sys_user su JOIN role r ON su.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON su.id = up.user_id AND up.deleted = 0
